title: Any caller reaching Cura's number is greeted by the resident's first name
method: static read + live POST with an arbitrary From through the Flask test client
observed_at_discovery: POST /voice/inbound with From=+15550009999 returned: <Say ...>Hello, Margaret. It's Cura. I'm glad you called. ... Press 3 if you want to report something suspicious. Press 4 if you need help.</Say>. The route body never references request.form['From'] or Caller. Cura's own scam_shield treats 'a stranger who already knows her name' as the opening move of an elder-fraud call, and this endpoint hands that out to anyone who dials. Press 4 from the same unknown number fires on_help_requested and pages the caregiver. pytest exit 1: 1 failed of 2 without Flask, 2 failed of 2 with Flask.
